summary: TEG Overseas, Inc. (formerly StageWise Strategies Corp., a Nevada shell with principal offices in Tashkent) filed an 8-K/A updating its October 14, 2026 report on the acquisition of TEG SPV Participatory Interests. The filing confirms the mandatory Uzbekistan unified state register entry occurred October 14, 2026, making the Company a registered participant of TEG SPV under Uzbek law. Concurrently, TEG SPV designees replaced the prior board (Mendiratta as Chair; Davis, Kasher, Sharko, Abduvakhitova), and the fiscal year changed. No price, stake, or premium was disclosed. Watch for audited TEG SPV financials and disclosure of consideration or ownership split.
